lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'I cannot believe we're making more of these instead of episodes...'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: (Gasp) 'A theme song, that's what I need!'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'A BADASS theme song for MY Cell Games:'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'Presented by HETAP!'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'I wonder, could they get me JAM Project?'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'Well, on this short of time frame...'

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: 'What day is it anyway?'

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: Master, I believe we have arrived.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Oh my G-- I'm a sun dial for pests!

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: I'm surprised you even found this place, Genos.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: The heck does 28KS.5 mean?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I needed to be specific.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I needed to be WAY more specific with my message.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Hi, I'm Saitama, Hero for fun, or... well...

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: I mean I'm technically employed by the Hero Association, but, uhh--

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: He's here to end your miserable life, *monster*!

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Yeah. What the cyborg said.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Ah, good. And *how* are you going to do that?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: * Stop one of my hearts?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: * Stop one of my hearts? * Blow my torso up?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: * Stop one of my hearts? * Blow my torso up? * Or play me in a children's card game?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Which, admittedly, was actually kinda fun.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: I was thinking about punching you, actually.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Well, as long as it's not keeping you from your chemotherapy.

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: Master! Allow *me* to take point.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: You sure about that, Geny?

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: You kinda know how this goes, right?

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: I recently received several performance upgrades from the genius, Dr. Kuseno.

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: I assure you, this first attack...

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: will be the finishing blow!

lines.speaker: Genos
lines.text: Huaaagh!!!
Shock horror! ;)

lines.speaker: Both Sarcastic Xd
lines.text: CELL: Oh wow, who saw that one coming? SAITAMA: Oh wow, who saw that one coming?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Ha! You owe me HETAP. SAITAMA: Ha! You owe me HETAP.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Ha!! You owe me *two* HETAPS! SAITAMA: Ha!! You owe me *two* HETAPS!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: (Sigh) SAITAMA: (Sigh)
Seriously, Genos, why did you even show up?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: How about you, Caillou?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: You wanna throw that *punch* now?

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Oh, I just tag along with him.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: I'm actually gonna wait for the tournament.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: If there's a bunch of strong guys showing up, I don't want to miss it.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Well, then, *Caped Baldy*, if you want to be, literally,
the first person to follow the rules I set

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: ...then the tournament it is.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: You bet, cockroach king.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: But don't be surprised if I hit a little harder than Genos.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Oh, I'm looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: You and me both.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I'll see you, *tomorrow*.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Dang right, you--

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Waaaiiittt, tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: As in, *tomorrow* tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: The F***ing Sabbath, yes!

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Oh jeez. No can do, then.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: There's a sale going on at the grocery tomorrow, and our pantry is lookin' *pretty* barren.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: If I don't hit it up, we're just leaving money on the table.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Let's just do it Monday.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: You're joking.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: If I win the tournament... (Scoffs) *when* I win the tournament,

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: there won't *be* a Monday.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Nah, It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: Saitama
lines.text: Now, uhh, don't mind me, I'm gonna go grab Genos.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: ...That's it?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Seriously!?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I feel like I'm not the only one being blue-balled right now.
DBZ intermission
